sourceExcerpt: Im Gegensatz zu der voraufgehenden Konstellation weist die 0 «-Reaktion mit —■ hy auf die übertriebene Tendenz der sensitiven Beziehungsangst hin
romanianRendering: În contrast cu configurația precedentă, reacția 0e împreună cu −hy indică tendința accentuată a «sensitiven Beziehungsangst» (P 0−).
doctrinalStatement: Pentru configurația exactă P 0−, în care e este 0 iar hy este negativ fără Überdruck, Szondi leagă explicit P-Bild-ul de «sensitive Beziehungsangst» și îl numește, în secțiunea reacției hy negative medii, Testmerkmal al acesteia. Ramura cu hy-Überdruck este tratată separat de sursă și nu intră în această regulă.
conditions: hy must be the durchschnittliche negative reaction, with quantum level 0; −!hy, −!!hy and −!!!hy are excluded.
exceptions: Do not extend this doctrine to P 0− with hy-Überdruck.
Do not promote the neighboring statements about moralische Färbung, paranoider Zug, paranoide Affektreaktion in schweren Fällen, paranoide Neurosen or Hypochondrie into this minimal rule.
scopeNotes: Preserve the historical Szondian term «sensitive Beziehungsangst» rather than translating it into a contemporary diagnosis such as social anxiety disorder or attachment anxiety.

The configuration does not establish a contemporary psychiatric diagnosis, an actual biographical relationship history, a current real-world anxiety state, a global personality trait, or a SERIES-level disposition.
No paranoid/severe branch is executable from this doctrine without its own source-complete trigger and authorization.
ambiguities: Canonical DOCX text around U001755 is OCR-corrupted in the word «sensitive Beziehungsangst»; the same expression is clear at U001652, while the ordinary-versus-Überdruck hy distinction is structurally explicit in U001748 and U001754.
reviewNotes: Clinician-doctrinal promotion explicitly approved for the minimal P 0− without hy-Überdruck → sensitive Beziehungsangst relation.
Independent primary confirmation exists in SZ_TRIEBPATH_2 U003184 («Sensitive Beziehungsangst — P = 0 —»), but no additional Triebpathologie pathology branch is imported into this doctrine.
